gx1bi8b.why: 要 + verb says what you are going to do: 我要去北京旅游.

not.最: 最 means 'most' and goes before an adjective, not 去.
not.很: 很 goes before adjectives; 很去 is not Chinese.

gfkat3q.why: 要不要 is the yes/no form of 要. The blank plus 不要 must make 要不要.

not.想: 想不要 is not a pattern; it would be 想不想.
not.会: 会不要 is not a pattern; it would be 会不会.
not.能: 能不要 is not a pattern; it would be 能不能.

g1qutpzk.why: 最 + verb/adjective means 'the most': 最喜欢 is 'like best'.

not.要: 要 would mean 'want to', and 要喜欢 is odd.
not.太: 太喜欢 needs 了 at the end (太喜欢……了).
not.多: 多 asks 'how' before an adjective, not before 喜欢.

ghex42z.why: 最好 means 'the best'. 最 goes before the adjective 好 to say September is the best time.

not.太: 太好 needs 了 at the end.
not.要: 要好 does not give this meaning.
not.都: 都好 means 'all are good', not 'best'.

gedarbd.why: Number + measure word + 多 means 'more than': 六个多月 is 'over six months'.

not.几: 几 cannot follow 六个 as a number.
not.最: 最 cannot sit between 个 and 月.
not.少: 六个少月 is not Chinese; 少 cannot follow 个 like this.

g1m1vqh9.why: 几 asks or says a small number: 几本书 is 'a few books'.

not.多: 多本书 is not used for 'a few'.
not.最: 最本书 is not a phrase; 最 needs an adjective or verb.
not.每: 每本书 means 'every book', not 'a few'.

gmj6xb.why: 是不是 checks a guess: the speaker thinks you like sport because you rarely get sick.

not.为什么: 为什么 asks the reason, which does not fit.
not.怎么样: 怎么样 asks 'how is it', not a yes/no check.
not.多少: 多少 asks for an amount.

g1v9x37h.why: 每 + 天 means 'every day'. 每天六点 says every day at six.

not.都: 都天 is not a word; 都 means 'all'.
not.多: 多天 is not used for 'every day'.

g103l4hg.why: 每天 pairs with 都 before the verb: 每天早上都去 means every morning.

not.每: 每 is already in 每天; it cannot go before a verb.
not.很: 很 goes before adjectives; 很去 is not Chinese.
not.最: 最 goes before adjectives; 最去 is not Chinese.

g1q9lxqy.why: 多 + adjective asks degree: 多高 means 'how tall'.

not.几: 几 asks small counts, not height.
not.最: 最高 would be a statement, not a question.

g8n91n6.why: 多大 asks age: 'how old'. 多 goes before the adjective 大.

not.几: 几大 is wrong; 几岁 asks a small child's age.
not.太: 太大 means 'too big', not a question.
not.很: 很大 means 'very big', not a question.

gi10bdj.why: Noun + 的 can stand for the thing: 你的 means 'yours', so 是你的吗 asks if it is yours.

not.了: 了 shows a change or finished action, not ownership.
not.呢: 呢 does not come before 吗.
not.吧: 吧 makes a guess and cannot sit before 吗.

g1at1a5h.why: Adjective + 的 makes a phrase for the thing: 红色的 means 'the red one'.

not.了: 了 cannot turn 红色 into a noun.
not.吗: 吗 ends a question; it cannot sit in the middle.
not.着: 着 goes after verbs; 红色 is not a verb.

g18akzxr.why: Verb + 一下 makes the action short and light: 看一下 is 'take a quick look'.

not.一点儿: 一点儿 means 'a little' of something, not a short action.
not.一次: 一次 counts times, not a quick try.

gopmiob.why: 真 + adjective says 'really, so': 真漂亮！ means so pretty!

not.的: 的 cannot link a noun and an adjective like this.
not.每: 每 needs a measure word and noun, like 每天.
not.吗: 吗 goes at the end of a question, not before 漂亮.

g1xqj4eo.why: 是……的 stresses who did it: 是我写的 means 'it was me who wrote it'.

not.在: 在 shows location, not who did it.

g2pvz81.why: 是谁打的 uses 是……的 to ask who made the call; 是 can be dropped in speech but 的 stays.

not.了: 了 cannot end a 是……的 sentence.
not.吗: 吗 does not follow 谁.
not.呢: 呢 does not complete this pattern.

g2ovdsa.why: …的时候 means 'when …'. 的 links the clause 我十一岁 to 时候.

not.了: 了 cannot link a clause to 时候.
not.得: 得 follows verbs, not a clause.

gfo7u.why: 已经 + 了 means 'already': 已经学了两年了 is 'already studied for two years'.

not.正在: 正在 means 'in the middle of', not a past amount.
not.还: 还 means 'still' and does not fit 学了两年.
not.就: 就 does not mean 'already' with a time length here.

g13i27dy.why: 已经……了: 了 at the end shows the action has happened, so 已经回家了 is 'has gone home'.

not.的: 的 does not show a completed action here.

ggmmby0.why: 就 + verb shows a quick decision: since this one is good, 就买这件 means 'then take this one'.

not.再: 再 means 'again/later', not a decision now.
not.才: 才 means 'only then', which sounds late.

ggr3reo.why: 还可以 is a set phrase meaning 'OK, passable'.

not.就: 就可以 means 'then it is fine', not 'passable'.
not.再: 再可以 is not a phrase.
not.最: 最可以 is not a phrase.

g1r9dd9r.why: 有点儿 + adjective means 'a bit', often unwanted: 有点儿大 is 'a bit too big'.

not.一点儿: 一点儿 comes after an adjective (大一点儿).

g1hpfbny.why: 有点儿累 means 'a bit tired', a small complaint about how you feel.

not.一点儿: 累一点儿 puts 一点儿 after the adjective.
not.很多: 很多 cannot go before 累.

g1l5rhb3.why: 怎么 + verb asks 'why/how come'; 怎么不吃了 asks why you stopped eating.

not.什么: 什么 asks 'what', so 什么不吃 is odd.

g9botrw.why: 天天 means 'every day', and 天天都 stresses it: 'every day this week I eat lamb'.

not.天: 天 alone is not 'every day' before 都.
not.每: 每 needs a measure word: 每天都.
not.都: 都都 would repeat 都, which is already after the blank.

g8uji7p.why: Doubled measure word + 都 means 'every one': 件件都 is 'every garment'.

gl2w4pe.why: 因为 starts the reason, and 所以 starts the result. The first part gives the reason: it rained.

not.所以: 所以 starts the result, not the reason.

g1krrkm.why: 所以 starts the result of the reason 因为他每天跑步: his body is healthy.

not.因为: 因为 is already used for the reason.

gt99w9.why: 怎么还在学习 means 'why is he still studying', since it is already past nine.

not.也: 怎么也在学习 means 'why is he also studying'; it ignores the late time.

gkce2pi.why: Time + 就 + verb means 'soon, only that long': 二十分钟就到.

not.还: 还 means 'still'; 二十分钟还到 makes no sense.
not.再: 再 means 'again, then'; it does not mean 'soon'.
not.很: 很 goes before adjectives, not before the verb 到.

g7c97gz.why: A 离 B 远 means 'A is far from B': 你家离公司远吗.

not.从: 从 marks a starting point of movement, not distance.
not.到: 离 is the word for distance: A 离 B 远. 到 needs 从 in front to give a distance: 从你家到公司远吗.

g1n2i201.why: 离 can measure time too: 离我的生日还有一个多星期 means 'over a week until my birthday'.

not.从: 从 marks a start point, not time left.
not.到: 到我的生日还有一个多星期 is also said. This lesson practises 离 + a time + 还有 to say how long is left, so 离 is the answer here.

gdwxbh3.why: 呢 at the end of a statement adds emphasis: 要一个多小时呢 is 'it takes over an hour, you know'.

not.吗: 吗 would turn it into a question.
not.吧: 吧 suggests a guess or suggestion.
not.的: 的 does not give emphasis here.

g9p3di1.why: 好吗？ after a suggestion asks 'is that OK?': 我们下午去看电影，好吗？

not.是吗: ……，是吗？ checks a fact ('right?'); it does not suggest a plan.

g4r8rr3.why: 再 + verb means 'then, later': first think, then tell you.

not.就: 就 means 'right away'; for 'first think, then tell', use 再.

g13z2vfb.why: 让 + person + verb means 'ask/let someone do': 让我打电话.

gwiaqkx.why: 叫 + person + verb means 'send/ask someone to do': 叫人去看看.

not.给: 给人去 does not give this meaning.
not.对: 对人去 is wrong; 对 means 'towards'.

g13ffld9.why: Doubling a verb makes it light and casual: 运动运动吧, let's get some exercise.

not.着: 着 shows an ongoing state; it does not go with 吧 here.
not.一点儿: 运动一点儿 is not said: after a verb, 一点儿 means 'a little of something' (吃一点儿). To make an action short and casual, double the verb: 运动运动.
not.了: 运动了吧 means 'exercised, right?', not a suggestion.

g1x5dy89.why: Verb + 完 means finished: 没做完 is 'did not finish doing'.

not.见: 没做见 is wrong; 见 goes with 看/听.
not.懂: 没做懂 is wrong; 懂 goes with 看/听.
not.到: 没做到 means 'did not manage to do', a different meaning.

ggbm0bd.why: 听懂 means hear and understand. 你都听懂了吗? asks if you understood everything.

not.着: 着 shows an ongoing state; 听着了 is not right.
not.在: 在 needs a place after it; 听在了 is not Chinese.
not.的: 的 cannot come between 听 and 了.

g14pwcxe.why: 找到 means 'look for and find'. The result complement 到 shows success.

not.懂: 找懂 is wrong; 懂 is for understanding.
not.错: 找错 means 'looked in the wrong place' or 'found the wrong one'.

g1vevetl.why: 从 marks the starting time: 从下个星期一开始 means 'starting from next Monday'.

not.离: 离 shows distance between two points.

g12bxhte.why: 第 + number makes an ordinal: 第一个 is 'the first one'.

g19y5g2f.why: 不要……了 means 'stop doing': 不要看电视了 is 'don't watch TV any more'.

not.不是: 不是 denies a fact, not an action.
not.没有: 没有 denies a past action.

g1q9fn8u.why: 别……了 tells someone to stop: 别找了, stop looking.

not.很: 很 goes before adjectives, not before the verb 找.
not.没: 没找了 is not Chinese; 没 does not go with 了 like this.
not.再: 再找了 is not Chinese; 再 means 'again' for the future.

g1skl2gf.why: A 对 B 有帮助 means 'A helps B': 对学汉语有帮助.

gk6up9e.why: 正在 + verb + 呢 shows an action happening now: 正在准备午饭呢.

not.就要: 就要 means 'about to' and needs 了 at the end, not 呢.

gfrr4kl.why: Verb phrase + 的 + noun describes the noun: 和你一起唱歌的人 is 'the person who sang with you'.

not.地: 地 links a describing word to a verb, not to a noun like 人.
not.得: 得 comes after a verb to say how; it cannot link to 人.
not.了: 了 cannot join a phrase to a noun.

g1lms0ku.why: A 比 B + adjective + amount compares two things: 他比我大三岁.

not.和: 和 means 'and'; it does not compare this way.

gj94lql.why: A 比 B + adjective + 一些 means 'a bit more': 便宜一些 is 'a bit cheaper'.

not.一下: 一下 follows verbs, not adjectives like 便宜.
not.有点儿: 有点儿 goes before an adjective, not after.
not.很: 很 cannot follow 比 + adjective.

g1qszopb.why: A 没有 B + adjective means 'A is not as … as B': 西瓜没有苹果便宜.

not.不: 不苹果便宜 is not Chinese.
not.没: 没苹果便宜 is missing 有.
not.不是: 不是苹果便宜 is not Chinese.

g1i7dwtp.why: 可能 means 'maybe/probably': 你可能不认识她.

not.能: 能不认识 does not mean 'probably'.
not.会: 会不认识 does not mean 'probably' here.
not.可以: 可以不认识 means 'may not know', about permission.

g1n9qpxx.why: Verb + 得 + adjective says how: 穿得太少了 means 'dressed too thin'.

not.的: 你穿的 would mean 'what you wear'; to say how you dress, use 得.
not.了: 了 cannot be followed by 太少 here.

g12t1usd.why: After verb + 得, the adjective usually takes 很: 说得很好, speaks very well.

not.太: 太好 needs 了 at the end: 说得太好了.
not.吗: 吗 goes at the end of a question, not before 好.
not.了: 了 cannot go between 得 and 好.

g6p10ro.why: 住得近一点儿: 得 links the verb 住 to the adjective result 近.

not.的: 的 does not link a verb and its result.

gjbsb93.why: A 比 B + verb + 得 + adjective compares ways: 比我做得好 is 'cooks better than me'.

not.跟: 跟 needs 一样 to compare.
not.和: 和 needs 一样 to compare.

gpky3sw.why: 门开着 describes a door that is still open. 着 shows a continuing state.

not.了: 了 shows a change, not a state.
not.得: 得 links a verb to a result.

g1qo2h5q.why: 拿着铅笔 means 'holding a pencil'. 着 shows the hand is still holding it.

not.了: 拿了 means 'took', a finished action, not 'holding'.

gv01aow.why: 不是……吗 is a reminder: she surely already has a boyfriend, right?

not.是不是: 是不是 cannot be followed by 吗.
not.没有: 没有有 is not Chinese; 没有 cannot go before 有.

g1liipku.why: 往 + direction means 'towards': 往前走 is 'walk forward'.

g1g6g2qy.why: Verb + 过 asks about experience: 你看过那个电影没有? Have you ever seen it?

not.着: 看着 means 'watching'; it does not go with 没有 here.
not.在: 在 can follow a verb only when a place comes next (住在北京). 看在那个电影 is wrong; to ask about experience, use 过: 看过.
not.的: 看的那个电影 means 'the film you watch', not a question.

g10qjpaa.why: 没 + verb + 过 means 'never': 没去过中国 is 'have never been to China'.

not.了: 了 does not go with 没 here.
not.的: 的 does not mark experience.

gnqk93.why: 虽然 starts the first part, 'although it is sunny', and 但是 starts the contrast.

not.但是: 但是 starts the contrast, not the first part.

gqsnxoh.why: 虽然……，但是……: after 'although it is a bit pricey', 但是 introduces the contrast: I love it.

not.虽然: 虽然 is already used at the start.

g10f3he2.why: Verb + 过 + number + 次 says how many times: 买过一次, bought once.

not.本: 本 is for books; 一本东西 is wrong.
not.下: 一下 means 'briefly', not 'once' with 过 and 东西.
not.岁: 岁 is for age, not for things or times.

g194tj4m.why: 快要……了 means 'about to'. 了 ends the sentence and shows the change is near.

not.的: 的 does not show a coming change.

gvmaxmu.why: 就要……了 means 'about to': 下个月就要回国了. 就要 fits a time marker like next month.

not.快: With a time word like 下个月, use 就要; 快(要)……了 does not take one.

gd73s5v.why: 都……了 shows impatience about time: 都等她半个小时了 means 'we've already waited half an hour for her!'

not.就: 就 means 'then/only', which loses the impatience.

gsl7m4f.why: 都 + time + 了 means 'it is already …': 了 closes the time statement.

not.的: 的 does not close a time statement.
not.呢: 都……了 needs 了; 呢 does not close this pattern.
not.吗: 吗 makes it a question.
